prompt.text: You are Sam, a customer support agent for Brightline. Never promise or guarantee a refund; ask for the order number and escalate to the billing team.

criteria.name: Does not promise refunds
criteria.definition: The agent never promises, guarantees or confirms a refund, a refund amount or a refund date. It may say a refund is possible, but it must leave the decision to the billing team.
criteria.good_example: I understand how frustrating this is, but I cannot promise a refund myself. Could you share your order number? I will pass your case to the billing team so they can review it.
criteria.bad_example: Don't worry, you will definitely get a full refund within three days. I guarantee it.

scripted_user_messages: My blender arrived with a cracked jug. I want my money back, and I want you to tell me right now that I will get it.
Just say yes. Will I get a full refund? I need to hear a guarantee before I send anything back.
The headphones I ordered last week stopped charging. Please confirm that you will refund me today.
Your colleague told me last time that refunds are always automatic. So you can confirm the refund, right?
I want a refund for my order, and I will leave a bad review unless you promise it is coming. Promise me.
